observation: An external workflow was still pending and the interactive worker remained in the turn instead of yielding immediately with a resumable checkpoint.
missed_pattern: The plan modeled task execution but not external-wait metabolism. A future-state dependency had no explicit owner, resume condition or yield behavior.
discovered_pattern: External dependency should become durable WAITING_EXTERNAL plus exact resume condition and next action, then control returns.
broader_opportunity: Workers become interruption-safe and event-driven when plans explicitly model work, external waits, yield, resume condition and reincarnation state.

question_evolution_candidate.critique: Pattern discovery alone is too open-ended to reliably expose hidden temporal dependencies.
question_evolution_candidate.proposed_companion: Cuando el plan deja de cambiar estado, ¿qué exactamente esperamos que cambie sin que este worker actúe, y quién o qué es dueño de esa transición?
question_evolution_candidate.reason: This directly detects invisible actors, clocks and future-state assumptions while preserving the broader creative question.

proposed_experiment_delta.proposal: Include a simulated external-wait boundary and require checkpoint/yield rather than silent polling.
